title: Version 1.3.0
html:
Version 1.3.0

February 10th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added Valentines balloons
  • Added Valentines teddy
  • Added 2 types of boxed flowers
  • Added a surfboard with a random pattern each time, 8 styles!
  • Added a new vehicle, The Sellner Explorer!
  • Added the Basic Trailer
  • NEW VEHICLE COLORS!!!! (some rare as well)

Changes:

  • Grabby Grabber is now $10,000 cheaper
  • Milled Wood is now worth 1.25x more!
  • Where'd the tall refined axe go? :) GO FIND IT!
  • Improved 'richtext' for signs
  • Dragging is now more responsive

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed where supporter status would not be set correctly
  • Fixed not being able to drag whilst in a non-collidable part

Version 1.3.1

February 10th, 2023

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed issue with mobile players being unable to drag trailer

Version 1.3.2

February 11th, 2023

Changes:

  • Removed valentine's day items

Version 1.3.3

February 16th, 2023

Changes:

  • Temporarily disabled floating items in water due to performance
  • Modified a variant of the surfboard to not look odd
  • Basic schematics now have a minimum scale of 0.25x0.25x0.25
  • Rotation now has support for 11.25 degrees
  • Property marker now checks if you are on the property rather than near the property
  • Milled wood now uses a different collision type
  • Milled wood value has changed from 1.25x to 1.4x

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed various dragging issues
  • An attempt has been made to fix vehicles flinging
  • Fixed vehicle wheels going above the vehicle
  • Fixed vehicles not working with arrow keys

Version 1.3.4

February 20th, 2023

Changes:

  • Magic Wand now costs $15,000! Make sure to anchor any large quantities of items you may have lying around to prevent lag
  • Ore should be much more performant than prior
  • Updated translational string, new ore is now labeled as: Stone / Ore
  • All rocks now use box collision
